name: Nekoyashiki Kotora
source:
Favorite Food: meat
Skills: athleticism, horse riding

Persia's onee-sama. A very talented woman, she became the vice-principal at a very young age. She is extremely harsh, a sadistic demon woman. All the teachers at her school including the headmaster fears her, but she loves spoiling her students especially Persia.
